One row per SKU / supplier order line. Repeat Order ID for multiple items. Track received and shipped quantities.
One row per invoice. Use a stable ID, customer, billing details, invoice date, due date, and Draft / Issued / Void.
Repeat Invoice ID for each line. Enter qty, price, discount and tax rate. Enter explicit 0% for no discount / tax.
Enter the applicable tax rate for each line. Add freight as a separate line with its own tax treatment. No rate is assumed.
One row per customer payment allocation. Split a payment across invoices with separate unique receipt IDs.
Record each cash payment once, including supplier payments. Order unit costs are estimates, not cash expenses.
Type an Invoice ID into Invoice!B5. Supports up to 20 lines. Enter payment instructions in A42.
Select Invoice A2:F43 and use Excel Print Selection, portrait, fit to one page. Check preview before sending.
Fix input records. Do not overwrite formulas. Once sent, keep a PDF invoice copy before changing source records.
Reconcile Receipts and Expenses against bank statements. Store supporting documents and resolve red checks.
200 invoices, 500 invoice lines, 300 order lines, 300 receipts, and 300 expense payments.
All calculations use fixed ranges. Extend formulas, validation, tables and summary ranges together before exceeding capacity.
Dashboard cash movement = customer receipts minus recorded payments. It excludes opening cash, owner funding and loans.
Operational bookkeeping log. No general ledger, inventory valuation, cost of goods sold, payroll calculation or tax filing.
Orders track sourcing and estimated costs. Expenses records paid amounts only; unpaid supplier bills are not summarized.
Customer overpayments appear separately. This starter workbook does not automate refunds or credit notes.
Dashboard sales and receivables include Issued invoices only. Do not record receipts against Draft or Void invoices.
Review Check columns. Dashboard totals are provisional until flagged records are corrected.
Received and shipped quantities must not exceed ordered quantities. Mark Closed only after fulfillment.
Workbook contains customer and payment information. Save backups and share only with intended recipients.
